what: BWX Technologies makes nuclear components. It builds the reactors that power American aircraft carriers and submarines, produces nuclear fuel, and makes medical isotopes and small modular reactor parts.
customers: The United States Navy, the Department of Energy, Canadian nuclear utilities and medical isotope users.
money: naval nuclear reactors, fuel and site management
components for power reactors, medical isotopes and small modular reactors
moat: It is the sole supplier of nuclear reactors for the United States Navy, a position protected by security clearances, specialised facilities and a certification regime nobody else holds.
risks: Revenue depends almost entirely on American government nuclear programmes and their funding
29 times earnings for a business growing in the mid teens
Small modular reactors are promising but have not yet generated meaningful revenue
opportunities: Revenue grew from $2.1B to $3.2B in four years with a 10.3% net margin
Analysts see about 70% upside, with 16 covering the stock
Submarine production is being accelerated under AUKUS, and data centre interest in small reactors is a new market
watch: Naval nuclear backlog and any firm orders for small modular reactor components.
